'''Hekto''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] possessing four [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. Members of the species were present in the [[Red Ronto]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Brink Station]] in [[45 ABY]].<ref name="Crucible" />
